run_ml_inference_her: run the ml_inference script to perform HER voltage prediction using experimental and computational CSV data
run_volcano_plot_pca: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot using PCA on adsorbate mean energies
run_parity_plot_cv: run the ml_inference script with cross validation results to generate a parity plot of predicted vs experimental voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate energies per bulk material from a computational CSV or parquet file for ML inference
refactor_get_computational_df_to_predict: refactor get_computational_df_to_predict to support additional energy descriptors or file formats
